event_text: Syrian civil war: The People's Protection Units (YPG) capture the city of Girkê Legê.
headline: YPG Seizes Control of Girkê Legê in Syrian Civil War
story: Barry gazed out at the ruined landscape, his feathers ruffled by the wind. 'Well, Susan, it seems the People's Protection Units, or YPG, have taken Girkê Legê. That's a Kurdish-led militia, for those not keeping track of the myriad factions in this debacle.' Susan pecked at a crumb on the nearby rubble. 'And by "taken," you mean they've managed to secure a city that's been ravaged by the Syrian government's shelling and the FSA's infighting. Quite the prize, really.' Barry snorted. 'Indeed. The YPG will likely use this as a strategic foothold to exert control over the surrounding region. All part of the larger puzzle that is the Syrian civil war – a conflict that's already claimed thousands of lives and displaced countless more.' Susan shook her head. 'One can only imagine the bureaucratic nightmare that will ensue when attempting to rebuild. Assuming, of course, that anyone is left to rebuild it.'
regret_line: One might regret the entirety of 2012, were one prone to such sentimentalities.
winner_line: The real winner was the chaos itself, which seems to have become a self-sustaining entity in the region.
